svg.text: Each card: Hi-Hat Level with an orange spread bar, Ride Pan with a spread, and Kick changed (faded handle = original value).
No handle covers the track. Rows are drawn at real phone size (375 px wide). The whole row stays the grab area, whatever the handle looks like.

g.text: Your finger rests over the track while dragging.
Same shape, pointing up from below.
Hand comes from below, so the bar stays in view.
Two smaller triangles pinch the track.
Reads precisely; the lower one is the one you hold.
Rounded tab with a point and grip lines.
Bigger target, still clear of the bar.
Round head under the track, tip on it.
Friendly; round head fits a fingertip.
Ribbed grey cap with a coloured index line,
set below the track. Most realistic.
Frame around the value, open where the
track passes. Nothing crosses the bar.
Small metal knob on a stalk, pointer up.
Realistic, but busy at ten rows.
Two stacked arrowheads below the track.
